key_facts: All 16 pass4 lane files were enumerated (table rows + prose/negative/dead-end/watchlist leads); 203 rows/groups, all numbered 1-203.
No new pass4 finding created; the pass4 verdicts stand (Affluent withdrawn FP; Burve/Kuru/Infrared/BTCX-NS-DMD/BigShot/Metis all closed).
Six funded, never-README-listed, no-verdict candidates surfaced as OPEN: Cabal LST (~$2.74M), shMonad (~$7.27M), Kipseli (~$694k Base), TOPS (~$92k), LVIN (~$91k), Metropolis DLMM VaultFactory.
The pass4 README blanket-closed 'gap chains' but left shMonad ($7.27M) and Metropolis un-deep-diffed; both are surfaced as OPEN.

The microcap 120-protocol watchlist is mostly PRIOR-COVERED (Adrastea/Hylo/Raiku/CatFee/Kyros/StakePoint/SunPump/Magma/Bio Protocol); only Vectis/LiquidLoans/Pay Protocol/Trevee remain unverified LANE-LEADs.
Cabal is non-EVM (Initia Move): no EVM RPC applies; the audit + DefiLlama TVL are the only handles.
caveats: Read-only; no transactions signed or sent. Point-in-time reads 2026-10-23.
OPEN is a triage label, not a proven vulnerability; plausibility/confidence are explicit per row.
TOPS/LVIN addresses are truncated in the source lane file - recover them in full before acting.
The World Chain 'Morpho VaultV2' resolves on-chain to 'AgentBank Deposit Vault' holding WLD (~$235k) - the label may be wrong; curator-gated either way.
DefiLlama data dumps (llama_*, lane_*.tsv, gov/*) were NOT counted as prior coverage (they are data, not verdicts).
Public RPCs only; no keyed URLs stored in this folder.
